# Lisbon Notes

## Overview

Five days in Lisbon in May 2024, staying in a small flat in Alfama with a balcony over a stairway. The city is built on hills, and I learned on the first morning to plan downhill routes and take the tram back up. Weather was warm and bright, 24 degrees most afternoons, with a cool wind off the river after sunset. I walked 12 km on the first day and paid for it the next.

## Food

The custard tarts from Manteigaria were the best thing I ate all week, warm from the oven with a dusting of cinnamon. I went back three times. A tiny place near the flat served grilled sardines on bread for lunch, and I would order the same dish again without hesitation. For dinner I favored the small tascas in Mouraria over the riverside restaurants, since the prices were lower and the portions larger. I drank more vinho verde than I meant to.

## Notes

Alfama rewards getting lost, but the tram 28 is the easy way to cover ground. Ride it early, before the queues, and stay on past the castle stop. The miradouros are the real draw: I watched the sunset from three of them, and the one above Graça had the best view and the fewest people. Buy a Viva Viagem card for the metro and trams. I kept a light jacket for the evenings and never needed the umbrella I carried every day.
